verdict.rationale: Zero is an open-source, self-hostable client that sits on top of providers like Gmail and Outlook, so mail stays with the provider. Self-hosters get direct database access (e.g., Drizzle Studio), and the MCP server exposes read tools (get threads, list emails, get labels) that could be scripted to pull data out. Leaving is therefore feasible, but only through workarounds rather than a documented export feature. missing for 10: a documented user-facing export of all data, open/standard export formats (e.g., mbox/JSON), coverage of Zero-specific data (AI categories, settings), any independent or hands-on confirmation of migrating out.
